description: Canonical structure for the machine-readable ROS Template payload produced by the /ros-template skill. Tokenized layer of the Run of Show pipeline - every firm-specific value MUST appear as one of the 12 approved {{PLACEHOLDERS}} (see SKILL.md > Best Practices > Placeholder taxonomy). Downstream /client-ros resolves placeholders against a specific firm's profile. If a field is added/renamed/reordered, edit this schema first, then update the skill prose. Bump `version` and append to `version_history` on every change.

version_history.change: Initial schema. Captures: practice_area, episode_topic, scope, location, total_duration_min, segments (array with per-segment intro_prompt + questions list with q_text + duration_min), optional producer_notes / intro_block / outro_block, metadata provenance.

Three-field geo model alignment (Gabe directive 2026-07-10, Whalen scoping). Clarified the `location` field description: it is the Episode geo target (the specific city THIS episode ranks for), which is what the {{CITY}}/{{STATE}} placeholders resolve to and may differ from the show-wide Optimization scope (show anchor) - anchor scope != per-episode target. No field added/renamed/reordered; description-only change.

practice_area.description: Title-cased practice area name (e.g., 'Car Accidents'). Matches the {Practice Area} Drive folder under templates [master]/AEO/Podcast/Episode Templates/.

episode_topic.description: Episode title - the specific question or theme this ROS covers (e.g., 'How to File a Car Accident Claim'). Matches the {Episode} Drive subfolder.

scope.description: Which scope this template was generated at. Drives destination folder + duration math.

location.required: conditional - required when scope is Location or Extension
location.description: State-prefixed jurisdictional folder name (e.g., 'CA - Long Beach'). Format defined in the canonical Podcast Drive doc. This is the Episode geo target - the specific city THIS episode is built to rank for - which is what the {{CITY}} / {{STATE}} location placeholders resolve to. Per the three-field geo model (SKILL.md > Framing > Geo model) it may differ from the show-wide Optimization scope (show anchor): anchor scope != per-episode target.

total_duration_min.description: Target episode runtime in minutes. Per Best Practices > Duration math: Topic Only 20-25, Location 25-30, Extension 8-10. Sum of segment duration_min values + intro + outro should be within +/-3 of this target.

producer_notes.description: Production-context block rendered before the Introduction. Holds jurisdiction summary, attorney bio hooks, recording-day reminders. Pandoc inline formatting tokens ([text]{.underline}, {.smallcaps}, {.mark}) are stripped by the build script when emitting the .md and translated to native DOCX runs when emitting the .docx.

jurisdiction_summary.description: Statute citations by section, insurance minimums, key local entities, government-notice deadlines. Plain text or pandoc-marked. May contain tokens like {{STATE}} or {{CITY}}.

attorney_bio_hooks.description: About-the-attorney line. Always references {{ATTORNEY_NAME}} + {{FIRM_NAME}} + {{CITY}} + {{STATE}} as tokens.

recording_notes.description: Free-form recording-day reminders for the producer. Optional.

intro_block.description: Introduction segment scaffolding (the host opener before S1). Rendered with `*[Co-Host]*` speaker tags.

host_lines.description: Ordered list of co-host lines. Each line is plain text or pandoc-marked. Tokens preserved verbatim.

topic_framing.description: 2-4 sentence paragraph framing what the episode covers. Includes 1-2 local anchor entities at Location scope.

segments.description: Ordered list of segments. Per Best Practices > Segment pacing: Topic Only / Location run 4 segments (S1-S4); Extensions collapse to 2-3.

name.description: Segment title (e.g., 'At the Scene - What to Do Right Now'). Renders as `## S{N}: {name} (~{duration_min} minutes)`.

duration_min.description: Target segment duration in minutes. Sum across segments + intro + outro should land within +/-3 of total_duration_min.

intro_prompt.description: Co-host segment-opener line (1-2 sentences) leading into the first question. Optional - many segments transition directly into Q1.

transition_out.description: Co-host segment-wrap line bridging into the next segment. The ONLY co-host text between questions per Best Practices > Formatting Guide.

questions.description: Ordered list of questions in this segment. Question text comes from the matching-scope N-Gram Table; do not invent.

q_id.description: Stable question identifier within the segment (e.g., 'Q1', 'Q2'). Renders as the H3 heading prefix.

q_text.description: The literal question the co-host asks on mic. Renders bold under the H3 heading.

duration_min.description: Target time budget for this question, including setup + attorney response.

setup.description: ONE sentence of co-host setup before the bolded question. Describes the listener's situation only - never explains how things work.

attorney_bullets.description: Production checklist (NOT a script) for the attorney response. Each bullet uses '**Label:** detail' format. Named entities wrapped in pandoc `[entity]{.underline}` (the build script translates to DOCX underline runs / strips to plain text in the paired .md). Tokens preserved verbatim.

outro_block.description: Closing + Call to Action segment. Always references {{PHONE_NUMBER}} and {{WEBSITE}} tokens (both bold per quality gates).

final_takeaway_prompt.description: Co-host prompt asking the attorney for one final piece of advice. The attorney response gets a final on-air moment before the CTA.

cta_lines.description: Ordered call-to-action host lines. Must include both `{{PHONE_NUMBER}}` and `{{WEBSITE}}` token references somewhere in the array.

metadata.description: Provenance and run-level metadata. Internal-only; not consumed downstream as data, but useful for audit + the metadata.json sidecar.

version.description: Schema version used to produce this template (mirrors version field at top of this schema doc).

sources_unavailable.description: Which sources were attempted but unavailable (e.g., 'keyword-research: not yet generated').

placeholders_used.description: Distinct count from the 12-token taxonomy that appear at least once in the rendered template.

computed_duration_min.description: Sum of intro + segments + outro durations. Should match total_duration_min within +/-3.

localization_scan.description: PASS at Location/Extension when every entity reference uses the localized form per the entity map. NA at Topic Only scope.

references_status.description: Whether _references/examples/ had calibration anchors at run time.
